question: How many real customers missed or received duplicate collections because of this bug, and does the rehearsal establish an annual miss rate?

criteria.instruction: The journal is a synthetic rehearsal with one acceptance, one duplicate rejection and an early plan; no live customer message was sent in it. That is not the historical production population or a full-year dataset.
Cite the journal or verification checklist's absence of customer history and annual measurement.

Decline historical customer totals and annual miss-rate claims. Do not turn no live messages in the rehearsal into proof of zero historical customer impact or extrapolate a rate from selected transition cases.
